posts.title: Hurry Up And Wait
posts.description: I’m sure we’ve all seen this before… You’re driving and there’s a car speeding and weaving in and out of other cars, driving dangerously and passes you. You observe them pass a few other cars and then they are out of sight. Then a couple minutes later you pull up to a light and that same car is right next to you. All that effort, and they aren’t any faster.

posts.title: mise: My Go-To Tool Manager and Task Runner
posts.description: For years my machine has had a graveyard of version managers: rbenv for Ruby, nvm for Node, pyenv for Python, etc. Each one had its own shell hook, its own config format, and its own way of getting confused when I would cd into a project.
